page.content:
Brazil's teenager of 1958 and the only man with three World Cups.

How Pelé connects

  • Faction: Brazil national team — Pelé is the defining player of Brazil's World Cup lineage.
  • Event: 1958 FIFA World Cup — Pelé won the 1958 World Cup in Sweden at seventeen.
  • Event: 1970 FIFA World Cup — Pelé's 1970 Brazil side is the tournament's most quoted champion.

What is Pelé?

Pelé won the World Cup in 1958 as a seventeen-year-old, again in 1962, and completed the trio in 1970 — the only player with three winner's medals.

Key threads lead to Brazil national team, 1958 FIFA World Cup and 1970 FIFA World Cup.
